vehicles.name: Ship 42
vehicles.avid_graphic_note: AVID graphic: cryo 3×, SF 2×, fully stacked — matches confirmed counts.
vehicles.latest_note: Flew Flight 15 (13–14 Nov 2026). Reached orbit, deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites, and was caught by the Pad 2 Mechazilla arms — the first catch of a Starship upper stage. Catch at T+22:32:34 (15 Nov 2026, 8:20 am AEDT).

extra_sources.title: SpaceX on X — Mechazilla catches Starship
